meta.title: Thank you for your enquiry | ComproDiamanti
meta.description: Free valuations and direct buying of diamonds, jewellery and luxury watches in Milan. La Diamanteria, established in 2009.

slots.grazie-contenuto-004: One of our gemmologists will review the information and attachments you have submitted and contact you using your preferred method. A final valuation requires an examination of the item.
slots.grazie-contenuto-007: An appointment at our Milan showroom, if needed.
slots.grazie-contenuto-008: An offer directly from us, with payment by bank transfer if you decide to sell.
